data.name: Athalla
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'athalassia', meaning 'inexpressible' or 'uncontrollable', often used to describe the fierce and untamed aspects of nature or warriors in ancient Greece. In Christianity, Athalla could be a name for a devout and courageous follower of God, embodying the strength and passion of the divine.

data.cultural_impact: The name Athalla originated from the Greek word 'athalassia', which was adopted into the Latin language as 'athalassus'. In the Christian world, it may evoke the concept of a warrior of God, embodying courage, strength, and valor in the face of adversity. This name could also be attributed to individuals who are deeply connected to nature and its raw power, recognizing the beauty and divine presence within the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Athalla signifies the inexpressible and uncontrollable aspects of God or the divine within us. It serves as a reminder of the depth and complexity of our faith, urging us to consistently seek and reconnect with the divine. Athalla may also inspire us to face challenges with courage and steadfastness, trusting in God's plan for our lives and embracing the strength and passion that comes from our spiritual connection. Overall, the name Athalla exudes a sense of reverence and awe for the divine, inspiring wonder and devotion in those who bear the name.
